info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud List Experience Cloud Sites

params.name: status
params.description: Filter sites by status. Valid values are Live, Inactive, DownForMaintenance, UnderConstruction.

items.docs: Returns a list of all Experience Cloud sites (communities) available to the context user. Includes site metadata such as name, status, URL path prefix, and template information.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Create an Experience Cloud Site

items.docs: Creates a new Experience Cloud site with the specified name, template, and URL path prefix. Requires the Create and Set Up Experiences permission.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get an Experience Cloud Site

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

items.docs: Returns detailed information about a specific Experience Cloud site including its name, description, status, URL path prefix, template type, and login and self-registration URLs.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Update an Experience Cloud Site

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

items.docs: Updates the properties of an existing Experience Cloud site such as its name, description, and status.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Publish an Experience Cloud Site

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

items.docs: Publishes the specified Experience Cloud site, making all pending changes live. Requires the Create and Set Up Experiences permission.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Navigation Menu Items

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

params.name: navigationLinkSetId
params.description: The ID of the navigation link set to retrieve

params.name: menuItemTypesToSkip
params.description: Comma-separated list of menu item types to exclude

params.name: publishStatus
params.description: Filter by publish status of the navigation menu

items.docs: Returns the navigation menu items configured for the specified Experience Cloud site. Includes menu labels, target URLs, access restrictions, and hierarchy structure.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Site Themes

params.name: communityId
params.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site (community)

items.docs: Returns the available themes for the specified Experience Cloud site including branding properties, colors, fonts, and images.
